2026-11-18 — Po web standard: shell, look, /diag, Tab window

Before (left) and after (right), captured with Playwright at 412x915 (mobile) and 1920x1080 against a local run on Azurite, light scheme.

1. Header, phone 412px, signed in

The Po shell: the full name upper-left (no wordmark-less glyph), the email and one settings gear upper-right. The account menu with its initial badge is gone; Catalog, the dev personas and Sign out moved to /settings. Indigo accent and Inter replace the green accent and Space Grotesk body text. The links live in the bottom nav below 640px.

2. Signed out, phone 412px

The header is the same one, with the existing Sign in button; the sign-in card sits in the page body under it. The build stamp reads v261117 (UTC commit date) above the bottom nav.

3. /diag, phone 412px, signed out

Was a dark monospace server page whose tables were cut off at phone width. Now it wears the app's header, gear and stamp and shows one card per dependency (API / Data / Services) with a Working / Not set up here / Not working badge. Still a server page, so it works when the WASM client does not.

4. Home, desktop 1920px, signed in

Route links stay centred in the header; the email and gear replace the badge and menu. Same layout, re-skinned on the shared tokens.

5. Settings, desktop 1920px, signed in

The theme chips are gone (light and dark follow the device). New Account section (email, Sign out, Catalog, dev personas) and an About row with the build.

6. /diag, desktop 1920px

Cards instead of tables; the Settings in effect list and Model health keep their content.
